how-27-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the cup, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-27-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the cup, then tap three things you notice.

how-27-02-compare.page: Put the lid on one specimen and the paper towel on the other: drag them, or tap one, then a specimen. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-27-02-compare.say: Put the lid on one specimen and the paper towel on the other: drag them, or tap one, then a specimen. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-27-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-27-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-27-02-det.page: Pick 3 files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name the change. Predict if it was warming up or cooling down, and watch the place appear.
how-27-02-det.say: Pick three files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name the change. Predict if it was warming up or cooling down, and watch the place appear.

how-27-02-partc.page: Draw a comic strip with four panels showing the Pot Lab: ice, melted water, boiling water with steam, and drops on a cool lid. In each panel, draw the water and label its state: solid, liquid, gas, liquid again.
how-27-02-partc.say: Draw a comic strip with four panels showing the Pot Lab: ice, melted water, boiling water with steam, and drops on a cool lid. In each panel, draw the water and label its state: solid, liquid, gas, liquid again.
